plan.notes: Official NJIT 2026-2027 catalog page 'B.S. in Civil Engineering', 4-year Plan of Study Grid (120 credit minimum; catalog prints Total Credits 120). Co-op Option A and B tracks on the same page were not transcribed. The catalog grid leaves several rows unlabeled; they are encoded with catalog-grounded placeholders disclosed here: third-year first-semester 3-credit row = History and Humanities GER 200 level (archived editions label this slot explicitly); third-year second-semester rows = one CE designated-elective choice (catalog inline list: CE 351, CE 465, CE 463, ENE 360, ENE 454, ENE 465) plus one History and Humanities GER 300+ level placeholder (archived editions label this slot explicitly); fourth-year first semester = catalog footnote 1 choice (CE 307, CE 351, CE 410, CE 414, CE 450, EnE 360, EnE 361) plus a COM choice (COM 339, COM 312, COM 319, COM 337, COM 316); fourth-year second semester = catalog footnote 1 choice, catalog footnote 2 science elective (Biology, Geology, Geomorphology only), IE 492 Engineering Management, and an HSS senior seminar GER placeholder. Per-term sums verified against the catalog's printed Term Credits (16/16/15/14/14/15/15/15 = 120).
